available: Version {latest} is available. This install runs {current}. Run the updater on the server to install it.
patch: Version {latest} is a patch release. It applies automatically; this install runs {current}.
patchHeld: Version {latest}, a patch release, has not installed by itself. {why} This install runs {current}.
current: This install runs {current}, the latest release.
ahead: This install runs {current}, newer than the latest published release, {latest}.
notRelease: This build is not a tagged release, so it cannot be compared with the latest release.
unreachable: The latest release is being read for the first time. This takes a moment.
unreadable: The latest release could not be read from GitHub. The check tries again each hour; turn it off with UPDATE_CHECK=off on an install without internet access.
badRepository: RELEASE_REPOSITORY is not in the form owner/name, so releases cannot be read.
banner.title: Update available
